svg.text: Push to the VPS, pull from the Pi
Concept 7 · the VPS has a public address: the robot knocks over SSH · the Pi is behind the home router: the Pi asks by itself
GitHub
public repo mini-smart-home
the robot: job deploy-vps
Secrets VPS_SSH_KEY: the robot's private key
Variables VPS_HOST (the VPS address), VPS_USER
(empty = house), VPS_KNOWN_HOSTS (the VPS fingerprint)
ssh -T, BatchMode=yes: no terminal, no password
StrictHostKeyChecking=yes: a fake VPS is refused
the last word = the marker
runs after tag-release makes the tag
Why the robot key is restricted
a member of the docker group = root-like on the VPS; without
command= (for example through ssh-copy-id) this key
= the house key. Because of the marker, the VPS answers
command not found → the job is red
release tags on the main branch
v2.0.0, v2.0.1, … made by the robot (tag-release)
after staging is green; only the robot
makes v… tags; a public repo: git fetch
without an account
GHCR (the image shop)
backend + web images, two processors (Concept 5)
public packages: pulled without logging in
VPS: a public address
example 203.0.113.10 · SSH on door 22 (Module 27) · the user house
~/.ssh/authorized_keys of the user house: a second key that only opens one door
restrict,command="sh /home/house/mini-smart-home/scripts/deploy.sh"
ssh-ed25519 AAAA… robot-deploy
(in the file: one line, split by one space)
command=: whatever command is sent, only deploy.sh runs
restrict: no terminal, no tunnel (ssh -L refused)
deploy.sh (center): latest tag → pull from GHCR → up --no-build
the robot reads its report: it must say v<version> deployed
PUSH
SSH, the robot key
the robot starts it
"without you SSHing in"
≠ "without SSH"
Home (home Wi-Fi)
router: no port forwarding
the router refuses connections from the internet into
the home: GitHub can't knock on the Pi
Gateway Pi (DEPLOY_PARTS=gateway)
the systemd alarm clock every 15 minutes (Concept 8)
1 git fetch --tags: a new release tag on main?
2 git merge --ff-only to that tag: only forward
3 docker compose pull: the official Mosquitto image (Docker Hub);
free path (center gateway): + backend and web from GHCR
4 up -d --no-build --wait, then check for Restarting
5 the journal: v2.0.0 -> v2.0.1 deployed (gateway)
can't be knocked on
(the router refuses)
PULL: a new tag?
the Pi starts it
pull images
(free path)
Push: the VPS
Pull: the Pi
who starts it
the robot (job deploy-vps)
the systemd alarm clock on the Pi
when
a few minutes after the merge, as soon as the tag exists
every 15 minutes + random ≤ 1 minute: at most ±17 minutes
after the tag is made, + the time to pull the images
needs
a public address, SSH, a restricted robot key, the VPS fingerprint
only outgoing internet; a public repo (public packages: free path)
when it fails
job deploy-vps red → Re-run failed jobs
the next round (15 minutes later) tries again
The author's lab: real SSH into a simulated VPS (a container), without GitHub and without a real VPS
with command=: deploy.sh runs, the marker ignored (exit 0) · without command=: command not found (exit 127, the job red) · a different VPS fingerprint: Host key verification failed. (exit 255)
